title: Remapping Text in Sentence and Word Tasks to Aid Reading With Central Vision Loss
official: Remapping Text in Sentence and Word Tasks to Aid Reading With Central Vision Loss
summary: Reading performance in patients with Central Vision Loss will be measured with and without missing text being remapped to different parts of the visual field in a variety of different reading tasks.

interventions.name: Reading text in the wild with remapping

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dense bilateral scotomas of at least 2 deg diameter in each eye covering the fovea
* Bivariate contour ellipse area (BCEA) of less than 10\^2 is obtained in a simple fixation task

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neovascular AMD
* Any history of visual disorders other than that causing the central vision loss.
